title: Kusoma kwa Ufahamu (Theme 8: Wanyama wa majini)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child names the features of a play, reads his part fluently with the directions, and answers and summarises from the play.

floor.prerequisite: Reads a part in a play.
floor.question: Maelekezo husomwa kwa sauti?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child reads the line sadly and summarises the scene.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Maelekezo ya jukwaani katika igizo ni yapi?" Kwa nini "Mama: Nenda sokoni." si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Maneno yaliyo kwenye mabano ni maelekezo ya kitendo, si maneno ya mhusika. Hayasomwi kama mazungumzo.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni kipi kati ya hivi ni igizo?" Kwa nini "Wanjiru alienda sokoni." si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Igizo huonyesha jina la mhusika, nukta mbili, kisha maneno anayosema. Hadithi huelezwa na msimulizi.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Nani alisema "Nitakuletea maji"?" Kwa nini "Baba" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Jina lililo mbele ya nukta mbili ndilo la mtu anayesema maneno yaliyofuata.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Akinyi alienda wapi?" Kwa nini "jikoni" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Rudi kwenye igizo na utafute mstari unaotaja jibu.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Neno "kuandamana" lina maana gani katika igizo?" Kwa nini "kukimbia peke yake" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Maana ya neno hutokana na mstari lilimotumika katika igizo. Soma mstari huo tena.

checks.question: Taja sifa moja ya mchezo wa kuigiza.
